content.label:
The latest UI is fast.
 Great tool. I can listen to so many shows now.
High speed, skip silences.

I’ve been using Overcast for years and I still love it. The developer obviously cares and puts a lot of time into this app. There are so many small details in settings that make this the best podcast player. And it keeps getting better.

I was excited to give transcripts a try after hearing them talk about the feature on ATP, but it's even better thank was expecting. Navigation via transcripts is incredible, you will never go back! 
I also love thinking about all the Mac studios churning away to make these scripts 😁 for some reason knowing the infra makes the feature even more enjoyable to use. 
My only note: I want to get to transcripts even faster! (It currently takes two swipes to get to the transcript screen; I'd love to see that come down to one swipe/tap/button somehow. Maybe put transcripts on the left of the 'main' screen, instead of right -> right?)

Anyway, amazing feature, absolutely give it a try if you haven't yet!

title.label: Makes listening a pleasure for me

content.label: I am interested in a range of topics.  I find that Overcast provides a collection of tools that allow me to follow several podcasts while managing mental overload.  Keep up the good work!
The new transcripts feature is awesome.  This app gets better and better with Marco as a podcaster himself and wanting things to always be better. He clearly cares and my most used app on my phone.

title.label: 30 bucks a year?  It’s a podcast app

content.label: There is no way a podcast app is worth that.  This apps is dead to me.

title.label: By far the best podcast app!!

content.label:
I almost never leave reviews, but this app is amazing and keeps getting better by leaps and bounds. The overcast audio engine does perfect and seamless audio adjustment (changing speed, dropping silences, boosting voices). 

And just when I thought it couldn’t get better, now it has TRANSCRIPTS! That’s an amazing amount of work and I’m so glad they put in the investment.
This has been my podcast player of choice for years. The recent addition of transcripts seals the deal. The features and support are 2nd to none.
New transcript feature is a game changer!

Have been using Overcast for years. This is the #1 app by a mile in my opinion: dedicated, knowledgeable developer, who has now spent his own money to buy FORTY-EIGHT Mac Minis to TRANSCRIBE EVERY PODCAST even private feeds! (As long as >1 listener I believe - incredibly useful to skip ads, skip ahead to the one section you are interested in, etc). Just incredible effort. Plus it cuts out blank (no audio) spaces which has apparently saved me 587 hours to date! Give it a try.
The developer is now fully engaged with slop and using it to work on Overcast. Expect bugs and data loss if you use this app.

Overcast is the greatest of all time. You can read many other reviews that say the same. I’m just stopping in to say thank you for the transcriptions. This is the killer feature that over knew needed it. I subscribe to way too many podcasts and sometimes I delete without listening due to overflow. Now I can skim everything and decide which are the most interesting. I can click on a word and the audio goes to that point. Absolutely brilliant!!

Still the best, has always been the best. Was a scary couple of months there after the redesign and I still don’t love it. But it works very well now and that’s what matters.

Also, the transcripts are incredible. Absolute game changer and a fascinating story of how they came to be. 

Good job Marco, more stuff like this.

title.label: Better than the Apple podcast app

content.label: I’ve used Overcast for years and have always found it more user friendly, less buggy and a better experience than the app that comes with your iPhone. Recently, the automatic download setting has stopped working unless the app is actively open - downloads in the background don’t work anymore. Can’t find a setting to change to fix this, so it’s my only complaint.
What happened to “Play Next” in the queue options? I use it to queue the important latest episodes while maintaining the order and placement of less important episodes. Please put this option back.
Unable to play podcasts as the app skips to a different downloaded podcast.
Im 75 yrs old and not looking to complicate my life in any way It’s simply the best My dog likes it too 🐾 🐾💕👣

Marco went and made the best podcasting app in the market even better. And free, to boot?!? In 2.0, Marco made the smart speed and voice boost features I love even better.  The placement of elements in the UI just makes sense.  And now we have streaming support.  Do yourself a favor and get this app. If you can afford it, optionally become a monthly patron to support the developer's work.  Keep up the great work, Marco!
Like the new rewrite.

I’ve been using overcast for years but been having a ton of download and playback issues lately which has gotten significantly worse over the last year. It’s gotten so bad that I will no longer be using this app.

I love that you can individually edit podcasts to start late and/or end early. The perfect fix for those shows that annoy me with their chit-chat that consistently takes up 5 or 10 minutes, some even longer! The adds or whatever at the end don’t bother me, but I could see where it could be annoying when you are waiting for the next episode, so voila! Its layout and options are basic with good organization capabilities are so much better than all the others that are not user friendly at all. The only shows I don’t use it for are ad-free shows on Amazon.

title.label: The best podcast player out there!

content.label:
After trying the major podcast players, I stumbled onto this one. The controls are very user friendly; there are options that can be turned on or off, but my favorite is the speed. When I speed up the playback, it continues to sound normal and the voices stay natural. You can set the speed individually while the rest use the default speed you set. 

I also like that I can queue up several podcasts and they stay in place, even if I inadvertently click on one in the queue. And finally, the updates actually add meaningful changes. If I could math it that way, 10 out of 5 stars!

Independent, Private, Simple, Reliable 

Built by a listener and podcaster. Marco brings genius and a deep understanding of audio and design. Been using it for 14 years every dang day. 
It’s all about the listening.

I think this is a great alternative to Apple Podcasts because you can customize each podcast’s settings to suit your needs. The ability to listen and pin your favorite podcasts to the top is a big win for me. It can take a minute to scroll through your podcasts, or you have to search for them every time if you have a large library. Having your favorites pinned is a great feature that Apple Podcasts lacks.

The only thing I don't like is that most of the podcasts (at least for me) won’t continue playing into the next episode. It will stop at the end of each episode instead. I’ve checked the settings for the main app and the individual podcasts, but I've still had no luck fixing the problem. I’ve noticed it’s not all the time, and sometimes it will continue episodes of podcasts that it previously wouldn’t.

Another issue I am running into is that it just automatically downloads all of the episodes from a podcast. I’ve gone in and changed the download settings under the app’s main settings, and I have gone into the podcasts and changed the downloads from automatic to manual, but it still downloads the episodes. 

Some of the podcasts have been going on for years, so it’s trying to download all of the episodes and it’s chewing up space on my phone pretty quickly. I still love and recommend this app, but I would love to see these quirks addressed.
Went to go listen to previously downloaded podcasts and had nothing. It keeps asking me to login.

This used to be my fav podcast app, but it wigs out over pods with tons of episodes. Can’t listen to Hormozi’s “The Game” anymore bcuz it stopped at ep 773 (there are close to 1K episodes now).

That’s not all. When I unfollow a pod, close the app, and reopen, it’s in “follow” mode again.  When I delete a pod and then add it back, it starts downloading ALL episodes even after changing downloads to manual (and previously changing the auto-download limit to 5). 

The developer ignores in-app bug reports and the last update was 3 mos ago. Not worth the trouble anymore. Moving on.

This is, as advertised, a better podcast app—no mean feat! Good performance. Solid feature set, without bloat or fluff. Regularly updated to squash bugs (and on average less buggy than the iPhone itself). Developer likes orange far too much—how about a “Pro” mode to match Apple, i.e. Space Gray everywhere?—but good design is opinionated, like the iPhone itself, so I live with it. Also, just a great app.
Overcast is snappy and helpful. The issues with the redesign have been fixed. The other issues I read about here are petty and seem like things related to iOS not overcast. It’s classy.
I absolutely love this app. The only down side is that I don’t have enough storage for all of them!

title.label: Overcast… I Wish I Could Quit You

content.label:
Overcast has a clear focus on making podcast listening the best experience possible. Hands down the two best features are:

- (As of the latest beta) you can navigate the podcast through the transcript… Like Apple Podcasts but with better overall UI
- Minimize silent pauses in a way that is powerful in getting through podcasts faster, but also feels incredibly organic and invisible

Every year I try other apps just to see if the grass is greener, every year I come back to Overcast.

10/10 would recommend.
Nice rewrite.

Been using Overcast for a couple months now and I find it to be a big upgrade over the standard Apple podcast app.  For one thing, I find I have to do a lot less tapping around to get where I want. I also find that app to be much more streamlined. A+! Can’t wait to try out the transcription features!
This platform is magnificent. Very user friendly with a wide range of options. Plenty of podcasts and it’s all run by one person. Hats off and I will continue to listen here and you should too.

proof that 1 developer can make a top tier app.

spoils me for other apps
Upon the latest update of iOS the episodes start and then stop randomly and I’m restarting podcasts all the time, making it unusable. I have deleted the app and reinstalled to no improvement

I pay for the premium subscription as I really enjoy the feature set and the insane amount of customization one can do to obtain the perfect listening experience (for example the AirPod one-click to skip ads)
Highly recommended

I really wanted to like this app, but its download settings don’t work. Even when setting download to manual, the app starts downloading all unplayed episodes, bogging down everything. I’m a few years behind some podcasts, so the download nightmare is real.

Too bad. I liked the queue feature.

Overcast remains my absolute favorite podcast app.  It is simple, powerful, and a joy to use every single day. The interface is incredibly intuitive and easy to navigate, even for newcomers. What keeps me coming back is how regularly the app gets meaningful updates that actually improve the experience, never just for the sake of change. Best of all, the developer is genuinely involved and is responsive to feedback and clearly passionate about making the best podcast player possible. If you listen to podcasts, this is the one you want. Can’t recommend it highly enough!

title.label: Difficult to track season and episode

content.label: I want to like this app and at one time it was superior to Apple's podcast app. I find Overcast's interface to be clumsy and obscures what episode and season you are currently listening to. Annoyingly it does not keep track of the Current or All view setting so I have to change that each time I open the app. The UI isn't very well designed as the key numbering for episodes is dark and clustered with other text. I've missed episodes and even an entire season because of the interface. In comparison, the Apple application has long surpassed this app.

I was going to try this app. But when trying to add my podcast...it was taking waaaayy to long. I go to the category..choose the podcast..and instead of just adding the podcast to my favorites and letting me continue to add other podcasts in the category, it goes to my library. Then I have to go back to the discovery area. This has to be an over site.
Very easy to use, intuitive and extremely responsive!
Enjoy Mikes perspective, calling out all sides where warranted.

title.label: I’ve had no issues switching from spotify and I doubt I’ll go back

content.label: I’m a huge fan of this app, I love downloads by default and I love supporting indie developers and podcasters more directly and without giant companies sucking up the money. I’ve had no issues, and it is better than every other podcast app I’ve used

I loved this app. Paid for the lifetime pro version. Somehow, that got unlinked. I’d love to support them, but I’m not going to do any more subscriptions. So it’s back to ads, I guess. Still using it, but hate that I lost my pro version somehow.

My old podcast app kept deleting my downloads even though it was set not to. 

I’m so happy I switched over! 

Works great, easy to use, and beautifully arranged.

Instant convert from Apple Podcasts, should have switched years ago.  

I almost can't believe how good it feels to see all my shows on ONE simple page, listed A-Z, and then they STAY IN PLACE.  Plus, in one morning I've set up half a dozen personal Best Of playlists.  

Less scrolling and searching, more listening 💙

I’ve used this app for several years.  Paid subscriber for most of those years.  On the iPhone app works quite well.  4-5 stars. Apple Watch integration is quite poor. Very difficult to manage downloads. Often a podcast download disappears while listening.  Multiple attempts to download file despite restarting app and watch.  Irritating.  1 star for watch use.
Works well and looks good too!

If you love audio podcasts this is hands down the best player for listening. Save time with smart speed, organize shows on lists, never lose your place to interruptions, read show notes etc … Listen on your phone, your watch, your car, your computer….(this is not a video app because video podcasts are basically controlled by YouTube and other big players; this is an app for LISTENING to podcasts on the open internet)
